runner_notes.repeatability: Run each case at least three times per model to distinguish stable failures from prompt-sensitive failures. For v5.1, query construction uses a five-part prompt when query engineering is enabled: common JSON contract, model-specific task agenda, task-specific prompt template with only required CSV tables, target-model addendum, and footer focus.
runner_notes.failure_family_reporting: Aggregate by failure_family_primary and failure_families, not only by case_id.
runner_notes.compatibility: Designed for the flat-root GitHub AIBioBench layout.
runner_notes.v6_code_footer: v6 uses original v2 case prompt text and appends reference SQL/Python solution code. The solution algorithm is present in the prompt, so scores measure code-following and JSON output compliance rather than independent data reasoning.

query_engineering.footer_policy: append only `Produce the output using the following code:` plus fenced SQL for passes 1-3 or fenced Python for passes 4-5
query_engineering.comparability: oracle-code control; not comparable to non-oracle benchmark runs
